tool.description: Generate a summary matrix from ABRicate results

param.name: abricate_reports
param.label: ABRicate Reports
param.help: Input file containing ABRicate results to be summarized

tool.help:
# ABRicate Summary
This tool generates a summary matrix from ABRicate results. The output matrix shows gene presence/absence, where: - `.` indicates the gene is absent - `%COVERAGE` indicates the gene is present
